blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) has rejected Malacañang’s call to temporarily suspend protests during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. The progressive group said that the gathering offers an opportunity to bring its criticisms of the Marcos administration and US policies to the international community.
